== Acquisition ==
'''[[Skill quest]]s'''
* [[The Throwdown in a Norn Town]] ([[Gunnar's Hold]])

== Notes ==
* Low Blow is a touch skill, not an [[attack]]. Therefore, you gain no [[adrenaline]] after use.
* [[Brawling Headbutt]], this skill and [[Body Blow]] could be chained.
* The Cracked Armor condition is applied before any damage from this skill.
{{anomaly|Although no damage type is specified in the skill descriptions, the damage does not [[Armor-ignoring damage|ignore armor]].}}

== Trivia ==
